svg.title: Ring attention overlap: buffer lifetime analysis showing the send-slot reuse race
svg.desc: Timeline diagram for a 4-GPU ring showing where send_buf[0] is overwritten before NCCL finishes reading it at step 2.
svg.text: Two compute steps fit inside one NCCL transfer → slot 0 is overwritten while send[0] still reads it
Fix: per-slot send Work tracking + GPU-side drain wait
